_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); discount-retail signals

pit_profile.why: Walmart: 'operates retail stores in various formats around the world and is committed to saving people money so they can live better'; 'every day low prices (“EDLP”)'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' (its Walmart U.S. segment competes with discount, department, drug, variety and specialty stores, supermarkets, supercenter-type stores and hypermarts, 'as well as internet-based retailers and catalog businesses'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2011 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Walmart: 'operates retail stores in various formats around the world and is committed to saving people money so they can live better'; 'every day low prices (“EDLP”)'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' (its Walmart U.S. segment competes with discount, department, drug, variety and specialty stores, supermarkets, supercenter-type stores and hypermarts, 'as well as internet-based retailers and catalog businesses'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2011 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B -0.09x; -19% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.85; conservative 2yr +62%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY02-FY11, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +7.2%/yr (FY12 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +11.7%/yr (FY02-FY11 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +17.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY11); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: WMT (retrospective, 2011-09-23) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.09x (-14.2% downside to Bear $58 / +153.9% upside to Bull $129) | Adj composite 1.85 vs market 1.00: gap +0.85 [UNDERVALUED] | -19% above the EPP floor $62 (14x FY12E $4.46) | Conservative 2-yr case: +61.5% total (+30.8%/yr) | At 11.4x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $67 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. comps +0.8% in Q2 FY12, forward sales +4-6% (FY12 net sales guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
